reason: Checked against the source: restore_game_zp (src/render_zp.6502) no longer writes &B2/&B3 (accepted G0257: render's .scrolled path puts the viewport back via buffer_to_view slot 2); its only reference to the slots is a dead LDA zp_save + 21 whose A is overwritten by LDA zp_save + 23. grep finds zp_save/REN_BASE+&800 used elsewhere only by render_bss_zero's start-up zeroing (writes), and ren_vars_z starts at REN_BASE+&822, so &BC15/&BC16 alias no other variable. save_game_zp runs only from render with ROMSEL &04 and ACCCON X clear (before cpu_sees_back), reads zero page only; removing the pairs changes no other RAM read or write. Not a PROTECTED line, generated source, table or raster-timed code; touches no zero page (it only stops copying it). Code after it in bank 4 under ANDY (render_bss_zero, shield, sky_off) slides down 10 bytes into the SKIP to &9000 (no ALIGN/ASSERT depends on its addresses), so it fits; any branch page-crossing shift there is a timing matter for the gate, not behaviour. Game state, screen and sound unchanged on all paths, since the saved bytes were never read. 2 x (LDA zp 3 + STA abs 4) = 14 cycles, 2 x (2+3) = 10 bytes, once per render.
